goal: Reject unknown or misspelled keys in sendall options instead of silently ignoring them
Prevent accidental spends of all wallet UTXOs or unintended transaction broadcasts caused by typos
agreement: Support for explicitly rejecting unknown fields rather than ignoring them (maflcko)
Objection to dropping solving_data addressed by retaining it, awaiting formal re-review (polespinasa)
Open suggestions to add and clarify a release note (kevkevinpal, vicjuma)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it protects users from severe unintended wallet actions due to typos in sendall options
Prevents silently spending all wallet funds instead of selected inputs or broadcasting unintended transactions
